kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
انغمست (form VII)
# اِنْغَمَسْتُ (inḡamastu) /in.ɣa.mas.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْغَمَسَ (inḡamasa)
# اِنْغَمَسْتَ (inḡamasta) /in.ɣa.mas.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْغَمَسَ (inḡamasa)
# اِنْغَمَسْتِ (inḡamasti) /in.ɣa.mas.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْغَمَسَ (inḡamasa)
# اِنْغَمَسَتْ (inḡamasat) /in.ɣa.ma.sat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
